name: AppAgg
requirements: Only store-distributed apps/games: the app must already exist on a supported store - Google Play, App Store (iOS/macOS), Microsoft Store, Steam, GOG, Epic, Meta, Nintendo, PlayStation, or Xbox
Submission is by store-page URL only: 'Paste the link to the app's store page and click Submit'; AppAgg fetches details from the store
Account sign-in is required before submitting (per third-party guide and site FAQ flows)
preparation: A live store listing URL for the app on one of the supported stores
Polish the store page first - AppAgg pulls title/description/metadata from it
An AppAgg account (sign in before submitting)
workflow: Sign in / create an AppAgg account
Paste the app's store page URL and click Submit
AppAgg creates or updates the app page by fetching store details
Manual review typically 3-7 days (per third-party guide); verify the created page afterward and report mismatched metadata via site contact
watchFor: Web SaaS with no app-store presence cannot be listed - the store URL is the entry ticket
The /add/ page is JS-rendered and returned almost no content to a plain fetch; drive it in a browser
Metadata is scraped from the store listing, so errors on the store page propagate to AppAgg
Use ?hl=en to get the English UI
countsAsLive: A public app page exists on appagg.com with price history/AppAgg Score sections and a link back to the store listing.
unknowns: Exact review criteria and whether non-game web services are ever accepted
Whether the outbound store link is the only link, or a developer website link is also exposed
Review turnaround confirmed only by third-party sources (3-7 days), not stated on the site
